This document provides a complete audit trail of all regulatory filings, inspections, and approvals for the facility located at 123 Business Park Drive, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105.

• Hazardous Waste Generator Status – EPA ID: CA000123456. No violations reported.

Section 2: Occupational Health & Safety

• OSHA 10-Hour Certification – All employees trained by March 2026.

• Emergency Evacuation Plan – Approved August 2025. Annual drill scheduled for October 2026.

• Fire Safety Equipment – Annual certification due February 2026.

Section 3: Administrative Requirements

• Insurance Renewal – Due October 2026. Current policy covers general liability, workers’ compensation, and property damage.

• Staffing Ratios – Comply with minimum 1:8 for non-supervisory roles. Current headcount 47.

• Training Records – All records maintained for 5 years. Random audit requested for Q4 2026.
